comparison.objective: Cut a graded clipper-over-comb taper on a training head.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate comb support and clipper motion to produce multiple controlled hair lengths.
comparison.success_condition: All tufts within row-specific length bands, no bald patch or ear contact, and tools returned.
comparison.reason: Bimanual cutting with irreversible length control is materially different from rigid-media separation.
